text.en:
Subsection (e) of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-nine hundred and twelve, entitled "An Act
making appropriations for public works", is hereby amended by making item nine, on page nineteen, under
the heading "Occidental Misamis", read as follows:
"9. For the completion of the school of the barrio of Talayron, Oroquieta ............. P4,000.00"

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1932.
